data: This fix handles clock skew by preventing negative elapsed times from draining the token bucket. When NTP corrects the system clock backward, `now - self.updated` becomes negative, causing tokens to decrease instead of increase. Without this guard, the bucket empties instantly and locks every caller out. The change also moves the capacity cap check earlier for efficiency.

The build process was attempting to compile the C++ core module from several source files including alloc, buffer, parser, socket, and pool. The compilation failed because the function 'connect_timeout' used in socket.cpp was not declared.
